maintenance_plan.name: Summit Comfort Plan
includes: Two scheduled maintenance visits per year

ac_not_cooling: Confirm the thermostat is set to COOL.
Confirm the thermostat temperature is set below the current indoor temperature.
Check whether the HVAC system has electrical power.
Check the air filter and replace it if it is visibly dirty.
blank_thermostat: Check whether the HVAC system has electrical power.
Replace thermostat batteries if the thermostat uses replaceable batteries.
If the thermostat remains blank, contact Summit Climate Systems for service.
basic_troubleshooting.air_filter: Most residential air filters should be inspected monthly. Replacement frequency depends on the filter type, household conditions, and manufacturer recommendations.

agent_restrictions: Do not provide final repair quotes.
Do not diagnose equipment failures with certainty.
Do not claim appointment availability without access to scheduling data.
Escalate potentially dangerous or urgent situations to a human representative.
